message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films across several sub‑genres—so you’ll have something whether you’re into supernatural chills, psychological dread, or outright gore:

| # | Title | Year | Sub‑Genre | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|---|-------|------|-----------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Psychological / Supernatural | Kubrick’s masterful build‑up of isolation and madness. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Psychological / Family Horror | A fresh take on grief‑driven terror with a haunting finale. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Social Thriller / Satire | Clever social commentary wrapped in a suspenseful thriller. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Survival / Sci‑Fi Horror | Tension built around silence; great sound design. |
| 5 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | Paranormal / Haunted House | Well‑crafted atmosphere and strong character arcs. |
| 6 | **It Follows** | 2014 | Modern Slasher | Unique premise of an unstoppable curse; creepy soundtrack. |
| 7 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Folk Horror | Daylight dread and unsettling rituals. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological / Monster | Metaphor‑laden story about grief and motherhood. |
| 9 | **Suspiria** (1977) | 1977 | Gothic / Dance‑House | Visually striking, eerie score, and a cult legacy. |
|10 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Supernatural / Urban Legend | Classic American remake of a Japanese horror staple. |
|11 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Meta‑Horror | Plays with genre tropes while delivering genuine scares. |
|12 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Found‑Footage | Low‑budget ingenuity and a genuinely creepy vibe. |
|13 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Period / Folk Horror | Slow‑burn dread set in 1630s New England. |
|14 | **Halloween** (1978) | 1978 | Slasher | Iconic killer, simple yet effective tension. |
|15 | **The Others** | 2001 | Psychological / Ghost Story | Twist ending that redefines the whole film. |

Feel free to let me know if you’d like recommendations tailored to a particular era, sub‑genre, or rating!
